$comment: Hard npm-tarball budgets against the fixed pre-8.0.0 baseline. Required public docs, editor/CEM data, declarations and runtime remain shipped; both byte ceilings retain the measured required-public-artifact exception and do not claim the mathematical 25% targets were met. The favorable incomplete-package probe still packed to 6,088,928 bytes, above its 5,872,345-byte target even before restoring declarations, CSS and other runtime artifacts. The integrated category-legend, native-button-state, table-sort and attribution changes measure 7,161,539 packed bytes and 29,561,077 unpacked bytes under Node 22.23.2/npm 10.9.8. Against the same-tool repack of published 14.2.0, required docs/editor/CEM/package metadata add 65,639 unpacked bytes, declarations add 12,441, and runtime/CSS add 10,382. All 3,164 public paths are retained. Byte ceilings equal those exact reviewed measurements plus the existing 34,000 packed and 140,000 unpacked headroom bytes, each below 0.5%. The file ceiling remains 2,500 base artifacts + 285 stable aliases times 2 + 94 measured non-alias remainder + 7 next-component files = 3,171. Fixed targets/baselines, exception reason, exact ceiling equality, the 0.5% headroom bound, and source/map/test/fixture/story rejection remain independently enforced. This release re-reviews both measurements against the final tarball: packed 7,213,158 bytes (+17,619) and unpacked 29,755,637 bytes (+54,560), each keeping its existing 34,000- and 140,000-byte headroom rather than widening it. The growth is the new public surface and the authored reference prose that documents it -- per-slice chart legends, the box-plot palette, the menu-item link surface with its noopener noreferrer guard, aria-pressed/aria-current forwarding, and the composed number-input stepper -- together with the regenerated manifest, editor data and llms artifacts those members appear in. File count is unchanged at 3,164, below its 3,171 ceiling, so no new artifact families were introduced.
